verdict.rationale: Fastmail's help center has a first-party "Templates" article, which points to a native saved-template feature for reuse in composing. The pack contains only the article title, though, with no detail on how templates are inserted, whether they support variables, or whether they carry attachments. missing for 10: documented template insertion workflow, variable/placeholder support, attachments in templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
